signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Lead onboarding for new brand and agency customers on the US side. Today that's white-glove: kickoff calls, account setup, and getting their teams and creators live.
Be first in every shared Slack channel with our design partners and customers. Answer questions, chase down creator issues, and turn what you hear into prioritized work.
Join sales conversations as the product expert when it helps a deal move forward.
Keep a current, evidence-based picture of where customers get stuck and what they'd pay for, so roadmap arguments rest on something real.
